newsitem.title: GERMANY: Blair to visit Kohl in Bonn on June 6.
newsitem.headline: Blair to visit Kohl in Bonn on June 6.

text.p: British Prime Minister Tony Blair will meet Chancellor Helmut Kohl in Bonn on June 6 during his first visit to Germany since taking office this month, the British embassy in Bonn said on Wednesday.
The visit takes place just over a week before the European Union's six-monthly summit in Amsterdam which is supposed to complete an inter-governmental conference (IGC) aimed at reforming the EU.
It will be the first bilateral visit abroad for the new prime minister, who will arrive in Bonn from a Socialist International meeting in Sweden.
